mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has risen monotonically from -13.7 to -10.9 over the last four weeks; this positive momentum persists because reopening behavior is sticky, so RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days will exceed its last-28-day mean.
failure_condition: The mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is less than or equal to the mean over the last 28 days despite the prior four-week upward trend.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM has risen from 31.6 to 37.6, indicating more frequent essential errands; this habitual out-of-home activity spills over into adjacent retail trips, lifting RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over the next 14 days when GROCERY_PHARM remains above 35, or it falls while GROCERY_PHARM rises.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT mobility improved from -8.1 to -5.3; when the weekly TRANSIT mean crosses above -6.0, commuter and shopper transit capacity is sufficient to support mall and downtown retail footfall, raising RETAIL_REC over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: After TRANSIT crosses above -6.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the following 14 days is lower than or equal to its previous 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS fell to -14.6 from -17.0 but remains below normal; when PARKS is below -14.0, outdoor recreation demand is weak and consumers shift some spending to indoor retail, supporting RETAIL_REC over the next week.
failure_condition: In weeks when PARKS is below -14.0, RETAIL_REC fails to rise or falls over the next 7 days.

mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has improved to -3.7 and TRANSIT to -5.3; the joint return of office commuting and transit use amplifies weekday retail footfall, so when both exceed their recent thresholds RETAIL_REC rises over the next two weeks.
failure_condition: When WORKPLACES > -4.0 and TRANSIT > -6.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 14 days is not higher than its prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL remains elevated at 6.0 and PARKS is negative at -14.6; the combination signals home-centric behavior with reduced outdoor activity, which suppresses discretionary retail trips and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: When RESIDENTIAL > 5.5 and PARKS < -14.0, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is greater than or equal to its last-28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime where TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve for two consecutive weeks, reduced policy stringency lifts retail and recreation; RETAIL_REC will rise over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both improve for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: In reopening regimes with two consecutive weekly improvements in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days is lower than its previous 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-essential-errand regime marked by GROCERY_PHARM above 35 and rising, households are diverting time and spending to grocery/pharmacy trips; this crowds out discretionary retail, so RETAIL_REC falls over the next week.
failure_condition: When GROCERY_PHARM > 35 and rising, mean RETAIL_REC over the next 7 days is not lower than its prior 7-day mean.
